message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, later by General Vasily Trofimov)
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Kaiser, later General Fedor von Bock)
• **Axis Allies** – Italian, Romanian, Hungarian, and German auxiliary units supported the German effort. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, on the eastern bank of the **Volga River**. The battle encompassed the urban center, surrounding suburbs, and the Volga’s strategic crossing points. | The confrontation became one of the war’s most brutal and decisive engagements, ultimately turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
